blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Eight former members of the New People’s Army (NPA) surrendered to authorities in Northern Samar and turned over 13 high-powered firearms. The Philippine Army described this development as another significant development in its campaign against communist insurgency in the province. The 8th Infantry Division (8ID), based in Catbalogan City, Samar, said the eight—identified only by their aliases Yanyan, Boy, Jamal, Angela, Junjun, Yana, Tanggol and Sigma—decided to abandon the armed struggle and return to civilian life through government reintegration programs.
